declarations.explicit_statement:
theorem sum_parts_pairs (label : A ↪ ZMod p) {sizes : Fin m → ℕ}
    (P : Partition (A := A) sizes) (χ : ZMod p) :
    (∑ i, ∑ x ∈ partValues label P i, ∑ y ∈ partValues label P i,
      modularDistance (χ * (x - y)) ^ 2) =
    ∑ a : A, ∑ b ∈ part P (P.val a), modularDistance (χ * (label a - label b)) ^ 2

theorem balanced_remainder_size_lower (n m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ n) (i : Fin m) :
    (n : ℝ) / (2 * m) ≤ ((balancedSizes n m i - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

theorem row_sum_lower (label : A ↪ ZMod p) {sizes : Fin m → ℕ}
    (P : Partition (A := A) sizes) (χ : ZMod p) (a : A)
    (neighbors : Finset A) (hsub : neighbors ⊆ part P (P.val a))
    (q w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hq : q ≤ neighbors.card)
    (hpoint : ∀ b ∈ neighbors, w ≤ modularDistance (χ * (label a - label b)) ^ 2) :
    q * w ≤ ∑ b ∈ part P (P.val a), modularDistance (χ * (label a - label b)) ^ 2

theorem far_labels_card (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (m t : ℝ) (χ : ZMod p)
    (hχ : χ ≠ 0) (hD : χ ∉ concentratedFrequencies S m t) (a : S) :
    (S.card : ℝ) / 4 ≤
      ((Finset.univ : Finset S).filter (fun b =>
        8 * Real.sqrt (t / m) < modularDistance (χ * (a.val - b.val)))).card

theorem balanced_energy_ge_rows (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ S.card) (P : BalancedPartitions S m) (χ : ZMod p)
    (L : ℝ) (hrows : ∀ a : S, L ≤ ∑ b ∈ part P (P.val a),
      modularDistance (χ * (a.val - b.val)) ^ 2) :
    (m : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * (S.card : ℝ) ^ 2) * (S.card * L) ≤
      partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ

theorem energy_ge_two_of_far_counts (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ S.card) (P : BalancedPartitions S m) (χ : ZMod p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hcounts : ∀ a : S, (S.card : ℝ) / (16 * m) ≤
      ((part P (P.val a)).filter (fun b =>
        8 * Real.sqrt (t / m) < modularDistance (χ * (a.val - b.val)))).card) :
    2 * t ≤ partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ

theorem energy_ge_two_of_near_counts (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ S.card) (P : BalancedPartitions S m) (χ center : ZMod p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hE : 2000 * t ≤ (m : ℝ) * pairEnergy S χ)
    (hcounts : ∀ a : S,
      a.val ∉ phaseInterval χ center (16 * Real.sqrt (t / m)) →
      (S.card : ℝ) / (4 * m) ≤
        ((part P (P.val a)).filter (fun b =>
          b.val ∈ phaseInterval χ center (8 * Real.sqrt (t / m)))).card) :
    2 * t ≤ partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ

theorem source_union_exp_le (n m : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hu : (m : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * n / Real.log n)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hcrate : 10 * c ≤ 1000) :
    (n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) / (c * m)) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 9

theorem eventProbability_exists_le {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (E : ι → Ω → Prop) :
    eventProbability (fun x => ∃ i, E i x) ≤ ∑ i, eventProbability (E i)

theorem eventProbability_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (E F : Ω → Prop) (h : ∀ x, E x → F x) : eventProbability E ≤ eventProbability F

theorem far_count_bad_probability_le (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ S.card) (χ : ZMod p) (hχ : χ ≠ 0) (t : ℝ)
    (hD : χ ∉ concentratedFrequencies S m t) (a : S) :
    eventProbability (fun P : BalancedPartitions S m =>
      (((part P (P.val a)).filter (fun b =>
        8 * Real.sqrt (t / m) < modularDistance (χ * (a.val - b.val)))).card : ℝ) <
        (S.card : ℝ) / (16 * m)) ≤ Real.exp (-(S.card : ℝ) / (64 * m))

theorem nonconcentrated_probability_le (S : Finset (ZMod p))
    (hn : 2 ≤ S.card) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hu : (m : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * S.card / Real.log S.card)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (χ : ZMod p) (hχ : χ ≠ 0)
    (hD : χ ∉ concentratedFrequencies S m t) :
    eventProbability (fun P : BalancedPartitions S m =>
      partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ < 2 * t) ≤
      1 / (S.card : ℝ) ^ 9

theorem near_labels_card (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (χ center : ZMod p) (m t : ℝ)
    (hc : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * S.card ≤
      (S ∩ phaseInterval χ center (8 * Real.sqrt (t / m))).card) :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card S - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((Finset.univ : Finset S).filter (fun b =>
        b.val ∈ phaseInterval χ center (8 * Real.sqrt (t / m)))).card

theorem near_count_bad_probability_le (S : Finset (ZMod p)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hfour : 4 * m ≤ S.card) (χ center : ZMod p) (t : ℝ)
    (hc : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * S.card ≤
      (S ∩ phaseInterval χ center (8 * Real.sqrt (t / m))).card) (a : S)
    (ha : a.val ∉ phaseInterval χ center (16 * Real.sqrt (t / m))) :
    eventProbability (fun P : BalancedPartitions S m =>
      (((part P (P.val a)).filter (fun b =>
        b.val ∈ phaseInterval χ center (8 * Real.sqrt (t / m)))).card : ℝ) <
        (S.card : ℝ) / (4 * m)) ≤ Real.exp (-(S.card : ℝ) / (48 * m))

theorem concentrated_probability_le (S : Finset (ZMod p))
    (hn : 2 ≤ S.card) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hu : (m : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * S.card / Real.log S.card)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (χ : ZMod p)
    (hχ : χ ∈ concentratedFrequencies S m t \ smallEnergyFrequencies S m (2000 * t)) :
    eventProbability (fun P : BalancedPartitions S m =>
      partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ < 2 * t) ≤
      1 / (S.card : ℝ) ^ 9

theorem outside_smallEnergy_probability_le (S : Finset (ZMod p))
    (hn : 2 ≤ S.card)
    (hl : (2 : ℝ) ^ 24 * Real.log S.card ≤ m)
    (hu : (m : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * S.card / Real.log S.card)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (χ : ZMod p) (hχ : χ ≠ 0)
    (hB : χ ∉ smallEnergyFrequencies S m (2000 * t)) :
    eventProbability (fun P : BalancedPartitions S m =>
      partitionEnergy (partValues (residueEmbedding S) P) χ < 2 * t) ≤
      1 / (S.card : ℝ) ^ 9

precise_main_statements.source_relation: Contains the source positive-integer-t instance; formal nonnegative real t is a stronger valid statement.
Matches source Lemma 3.3; outside B is strict because B uses energy <= threshold. The proof weakens the resulting >2000t to >=2000t only when invoking a deterministic estimate.
Splits actual membership in D_t. Positivity and 4m <= |S| are proved from the original slice restrictions, not added analytic premises.

analysis.sample_space: The parts have sizes floor(n/m) or floor(n/m)+1, with the larger parts assigned the first indices. All functions with these fiber sizes are included. The independent-selection/product sampling is in prior proved modules; concentration averages the actual partition space.
analysis.conditional_exposure: For retained a and exposed i=P(a), the other members form the uniform k-subset of S\{a}, k=partSize(i)-1. The integration uses the proved exact conditional law and the proved finite mixture bound; it does not use the unconditional distribution of the containing-part index.
analysis.deletion_and_density: The population has n-1 elements. Far G excludes a because its self-distance is 0 and the radius is nonnegative. Near G excludes every retained a outside the doubled-radius interval. Thus intersection with the full part equals intersection with its erased remainder. The n/4 and 3n/4 original cardinal bounds imply the required (n-1)/4 and 3(n-1)/4 density bounds.
analysis.indexing_and_sizes: Balanced part size is used through Nat subtraction size-1. Under m>0 and 4m<=n, the code proves every remainder size is at least n/(2m), so neither an off-by-one nor a positivity assumption is hidden.
analysis.strict_thresholds: The checked hypergeometric events use strict real inequalities count<k/8 and count<k/2. Their complements are count>=k/8 and count>=k/2, so passing to thresholds n/(16m) and n/(4m) causes no rounding loss.
analysis.local_rates: The quarter-density conditional estimate is exp(-k/32), hence exp(-n/(64m)). The three-quarter-density estimate is exp(-k/24), hence exp(-n/(48m)).
analysis.deterministic_energy: The within-part pair sum is reindexed by each retained element exactly once. Normalization is m^2/(2n^2). Far counts n/(16m) and squared separation at least 64t/m yield energy>=2t. Near counts n/(4m), squared separation at least one quarter of the center-distance square, and the proved normalized tail >=200t yield energy>=200t/32>=2t.
analysis.union_bound_and_finiteness: Failure is included in a union over the finite subtype S. The actual finite event union bound gives n exp(-n/(64m)) or n exp(-n/(48m)); no independence among rows or parts is asserted.
analysis.logarithmic_absorption: With n>=2, log n>0. For c=64 or 48, 10c<=1000 and m<=n/(1000logn) imply n/(cm)>=10logn, so n exp(-n/(cm))<=n^-9. All rates and denominators match the displayed source bounds.
analysis.center_choice: An actual center witnessing D_t is retained for the fixed frequency and threshold. A center simultaneously independent of all t is unnecessary for these pointwise concentration estimates.
analysis.analytical_assumptions: The acceptance-level concentration theorems take no Fourier, anti-concentration, concentration-probability, constant-fiber, or independence hypothesis. Explicit counting and deterministic geometry supply those steps.
